draftNote: Read from one blockprint at the resolution of an online scan; doubtful places are marked in the notes, and the text has not yet been collated with other prints.
source: Zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: Chos nyid bar do'i gsal 'debs thos grol chen mo, pages 63–72 of the reproduction, from an undated Tibetan blockprint of the Thos grol cycle reproduced by the Buddhist Digital Resource Center as W23710 (text kha), read from the page images. It is a traditional blockprint, so no modern editor's work is involved. Two transcriptions found online, one of this print and one of another, were used to check the reading and are not the text. The page gives the print's wording and spelling. Three things are ours: the spaces between words, which Tibetan does not write; the line-end abbreviations, written out; and clear misprints corrected, each named in its note. Where another print reads differently in a way that matters, the note says so. Letters: the Wylie system (Extended Wylie for the Sanskrit words). Pronunciation: the reading style of central Tibet in the THL Simplified Phonetic Transcription (Germano and Tournadre, 2003), produced by rule from the spelling; a living reader's pronunciation will differ in places. The translation is new, made from the Tibetan. Still to do: the text has been read from one print at the resolution of an online scan, and doubtful places are marked in the notes; it has not been collated with the other blockprints.

sentences.l: O child-of-noble-family! Bodies those (plural) also, not large, not small, proportion-even; ornaments, colours, sitting-manner and, seat-thrones, each-own's hand-seals with together, and:
sentences.i: O child of noble family, these forms are neither large nor small but evenly proportioned, each with its own ornaments, colour, manner of sitting, throne and hand-gesture.
sentences.n: The sentence that the last part left for p. 63: it describes the forty-two deities just named. mi che ba mi chung ba, 'not large, not small'; cha mnyam pa, 'even in proportion' (cha, 'part, proportion'; mnyam pa, 'equal'). bzhugs tshul, 'manner of sitting' (bzhugs, the respectful 'sit'; tshul, 'manner'). gdan khri, 'seat and throne'. rang rang gi, 'each its own', rang doubled. phyag rgya, 'hand-seal' (Sanskrit mudrā), the gesture of the hands. dang bcas te, 'together with, and': the sentence runs on. de dag, 'those', the plural, as in 006. The other recension adds cha lugs, 'dress', after rgyan, 'ornaments'.

sentences.l: Bodies those (plural) also, five-five's pairs by pervaded; five-groups each to, lights five's clusters-by rim with together,
sentences.i: These forms, too, are pairs throughout, five and five, and each group of five has a rim made of clusters of the five lights:
sentences.n: lnga lnga'i zung, 'pairs of five and five': taken as the five buddhas, each with his consort, and so the five pairs; the words are short, and the sense is not sure. khyab pa, 'pervaded, filled through'; the other recension has brgyan pa, 'adorned', 'adorned by the pairs'. lnga tshan, 'a set of five' (tshan, 'group'); re re la, 'to each one'. tshom bus, 'by clusters' (tshom bu, 'cluster, bunch', with -s, 'by'): the rim is made of clusters of light. mu khyud, 'rim, border, enclosing ring'. The other recension has 'od lnga'i mu khyud, 'a rim of five lights', without the clusters.

sentences.l: the father's part holding's family's bodhisattvas and; the mother's part holding's family's female-bodhisattvas and: maṇḍala all one-in complete-way dawning comes-because: that, your yidam's deity it-is-because, face-knowing do!
sentences.i: the bodhisattvas of the families, who take the father's part, and the female bodhisattvas of the families, who take the mother's part: the whole maṇḍala dawns, complete in one. That is your yidam deity: recognise it.
sentences.n: cha 'dzin pa, 'holding the part (of)': in each family the bodhisattvas (sems dpa') stand on the father's side and the female bodhisattvas (sems ma) on the mother's. dkyil 'khor, 'maṇḍala', the circle of a deity and his retinue. gcig la rdzogs par, 'complete in one'; the other recension has dus gcig la, 'at one time'. rdzogs is not sure on the image: the letter under the r may be j, which would give rjogs, no word; rdzogs, which the sense needs and the other recension has, is read. Its last letters are cut as one sign for -gs, here written out. 'ong bas, 'because it comes', runs on to the command (the other recension ends the sentence with 'ong ngo). yin bas, 'because it is', is the print's b for p (yin pas), as in 006. yi dam, the deity a person takes as his own in practice.

sentences.l: O child-of-noble-family! Five-families father-mother those (plural)'s heart from, wisdoms four joined's light-rays, fine and clear, sun's light-rays cane-cord twisted like, shimmering(?), you-yourself's heart-at dawning come, and:
sentences.i: O child of noble family, from the heart of the five families, the buddhas and their consorts, the light-rays of the four wisdoms joined, fine and clear, come dawning at your heart, shimmering like rays of the sun twisted into a cord.
sentences.n: ye shes bzhi sbyor, 'the four wisdoms joined', the vision named at the end of the last part. phra la dwangs pa, 'fine and clear': la between two adjectives is 'and'. sba thag, 'a cord of cane' (sba, 'cane'; thag, 'rope, cord'), and dril ba, 'wound, twisted': the thin rays come wound together like a cord; the other recension has ba thag sbrel ba, 'joined like a rope', and the likeness is not sure in either. The print has me re re, plainly on the image; the other recension has only re re, 'one by one', and does not have me. me re re is taken here as the word of 003, a doubled-sound word for a flickering shimmer; it may also be that me does not belong and re re is 'each', 'each comes to your heart'. Which, cannot be told; the reading is uncertain. snying khar, 'at the heart'. 'char du 'ong ste, 'come to dawn, and': the sentence runs on into the four lights, one by one.

sentences.l: That moreover: first, Vairocana's heart from, dharma-expanse's wisdom, white and bright, lustrous and fearsome's light-ray's strip, one, you-yourself's heart with joined-way dawning comes.
sentences.i: First, from the heart of Vairocana, a strip of light-rays of the wisdom of the expanse of reality, white and bright, lustrous and fearsome, comes dawning, joined to your heart.
sentences.n: de yang, 'and that, namely': it opens the account of the four lights. dang po, 'first'; the other recension dang por. chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes, 'the wisdom of the expanse of reality', Vairocana's (004). nyam nga ba, 'fearsome', here in its usual spelling, where 003 and 006 printed nyams nga ba. snam bu, 'a strip of woollen cloth': a band of light. cig, 'one', makes it 'a strip'. 'brel mar, 'joined, connected' ('brel, 'be connected', with mar, as in gshibs mar, 'side by side').

sentences.l: O child-of-noble-family! Wisdom's light with together, impure delusion's appearances, six-kinds' lights six also, as-one(?) dawning come, and: which, if-one-says:
sentences.i: O child of noble family, together with the light of wisdom the six lights of the six kinds of beings, the impure appearances of delusion, will also dawn all together. Which are they?
sentences.n: ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba, 'the impure appearances of delusion'. rigs drug, 'the six kinds', the six realms of rebirth, whose dull lights came one at a time beside the wisdom lights of the days before. gcig, 'one', is taken as 'together, at once', as dus gcig la, 'at one time', in 006; the sense is not sure. The other recension has rigs drug gi 'od 'char du 'ong ste, without drug kyang and gcig. 'ong te has te where the rule gives ste after -ng, the print's habit (as bzhag te in 002). gang zhe na, 'if one asks which', with zhe, the form zhes takes before na: the way a list is opened.

sentences.i: If you are afraid of the light of pure wisdom and attached to the impure light of saṃsāra, the light of the six kinds, you will take a body among the six kinds of beings, and there will be no time when you are freed from the great ocean of suffering that is saṃsāra. How wearisome!
sentences.n: chags na ni, 'if attached, then'. sentences.i: Turn with devotion, thinking, 'The light-rays of the compassionate wisdom of the Blessed Ones, the Sugatas of the five families, have come to take hold of me with compassion: I go to them for refuge.'
sentences.n: The refuge formula of the days before, now for all five families at once. bde bar gshegs pa, 'one gone to bliss' (Sanskrit sugata), a name of a buddha. 'od zer gyis, 'by the light-rays', marks them as the doers of 'dzin pa, 'holding': it is the light-rays that hold, and that have come. thugs rjes 'dzin pa, 'to hold with compassion' (thugs rje, 'compassion', with -s, 'by'): the hook of compassion of the days before. byon, the past (and imperative) stem of 'byon, the respectful verb 'to come'. byon par 'dug gis, 'have come, and so': 'dug after a verb, as in 002 (bab nas 'dug gis), with gis, 'and so'. The other recension has 'od zer without gyis, 'byon par 'dug gi, with the present stem, and mos pa mdzod la, with the respectful 'do', where the print has gyis la.

sentences.l:
Alas! Poisons five fierce-by in-saṃsāra wandering's time,
wisdoms four joined bright's light-path on,
the Blessed victors five-families-by the-way lead!
Expanse's great-mothers five by from-behind support!
Impure six-kinds light-paths (from?) freeing I-pray;
the between fearful's narrow-passage from having-freed, also,
pure's realms supreme five-to bringing I-pray!
sentences.i:
Alas! When I wander in saṃsāra through the five fierce poisons,
on the bright light-path of the four wisdoms joined
may the Blessed Victors of the five families lead the way,
may the five great mothers of the expanse support me from behind.
I pray you, free me from the impure light-paths of the six kinds,
and when you have freed me from the fearful narrow passage of the bardo,
I pray you, bring me to the five supreme pure realms.
sentences.n: The prayer of the days before, now for the five families together, nine syllables to the line after kye ma, and seven lines where the days before had six. kye ma is the print's other spelling of kyai ma, used beside it. dug lnga, 'the five poisons', the poisons of the five days: delusion, anger, pride, desire and jealousy. rgyal ba, 'victor', a name of a buddha; rigs lngas, 'by the five families', with -s, 'by'. dbyings kyi yum chen, 'the great mothers of the expanse', the five consorts; yis, 'by', after a vowel; the other recension has yum mchog rigs lnga'i yum gyis, 'by the supreme mothers, the mothers of the five families'. skyor, 'hold up!', the present and imperative stem, as on the first and fifth days. The fifth line has no las, 'from': ma dag rigs drug 'od lam bsgral du gsol is read as 'free me from the impure light-paths of the six kinds', the sense the next line gives with las; the other recension has bar do rigs drug 'od lam, 'the light-paths of the six kinds in the bardo'. bsgral, the past and future stem of sgrol, 'to free' (sgrol / bsgral / bsgral / sgrol), future with du gsol and past in bsgral nas, 'having freed'; bskyal, the past and future stem of skyel, 'to bring' (skyel / bskyal / bskyal / skyol), each with du gsol, 'I pray that you'. zhing mchog lnga, 'the five supreme realms', the realms of the five buddhas (006); ru, 'to', after a vowel, as in sa ru.

sentences.n: nyon mongs pa, 'affliction' (Sanskrit kleśa), the name for the poisons of the mind; gti mug, 'delusion', the poison of the first day. las grub pa'i, 'formed from', as in 006. The other recension has 'od lam gyis kyang, with -gyis marking the light-path as the one that comes; the sense is the same.

sentences.i: To point this out at that time, call the dead person by name and say this: O child of noble family, listen without distraction.
sentences.n: The formula of the days before (006). rang, 'self', stands before ngo sprad pa here, where the other recension has yang, 'again'. sentences.l: Day seventh on, habitual-tendencies in-the-expanse purified's lights five, multicoloured, dawning come.
sentences.i: On the seventh day the five lights of the habitual tendencies purified in the expanse will dawn in many colours.
sentences.n: bag chags dbyings su dag pa, 'habitual tendencies purified in the expanse': the traces of past action cleansed into the space of reality. 'od lnga, 'the five lights'; khra bo, 'multicoloured, variegated'. The other recension has 'od khra bo, without lnga, and shar du for 'char du.

sentences.l: Rainbow and light-as thick's centre-in, ripening's knowledge-holder unsurpassed, Lotus Dance's Lord so-called, body-colour lights five's radiance with endowed, mother sky-goer-woman red body to embracing, curved-knife and skull-blood holding, and, gazing-manner's seal sky-to making, one, dawning comes.
sentences.i: In the midst of a dense mass of rainbow and light there dawns the unsurpassed knowledge-holder of full ripening, called Lord of the Lotus Dance, his body glowing with the radiance of the five lights, his consort, a red ḍākinī, embracing him; he holds a curved knife and a skull full of blood, and makes the gesture of gazing toward the sky.
sentences.n: 'thib pa, 'to gather thick', as clouds do; the other recension has 'ja' dang 'od du thim pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su, 'in the centre of a maṇḍala dissolving into rainbow and light'. rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin, 'the knowledge-holder of full ripening' (rnam par smin pa, 'fully ripened'): he stands in the centre; the next part names the knowledge-holders of the four directions. bla na med pa, 'with none above, unsurpassed'. Padma gar gyi dbang phyug, 'Lord of the Lotus Dance' (padma, 'lotus'; gar, 'dance'; dbang phyug, 'lord'; Sanskrit Padmanarteśvara); the name can also be taken as 'Lotus, Lord of Dance', with gar gyi dbang phyug together. sku mdog, 'body colour', the respectful word. mkha' 'gro ma, 'she who goes in the sky' (Sanskrit ḍākinī); the print writes mkha' 'gro with one ' for both syllables (མཁའགྲོ), a contraction written out here. 'khril ba, 'winding about, embracing'. gri gug, 'curved knife'; thod khrag, 'skull and blood', a skull cup full of blood. 'dzin cing, 'holding, and'; the other recension has gri gug dang thod khrag gi gar mdzad cing, 'dancing with the curved knife and the skull of blood'. blta stangs, 'manner of looking, gaze' (blta, 'to look'; stangs, 'manner'; the other recension lta stangs); phyag rgya, 'gesture'; mdzad pa, the respectful 'make'. cig, 'one', makes it 'a knowledge-holder'. The part ends here, in the middle of p. 72.

glossary.བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས: bcom ldan 'das — the Blessed One, a title of a buddha (bcom ldan 'das, Sanskrit bhagavān; 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.བཏབ་པས: btab pas — by having given, because it is given (btab pa + -s 'by') · because it is made, of a prayer (smon lam btab pas 'because the prayer is made')
glossary.བདུན་པ: bdun pa — seventh (bdun 'seven' + -pa): zhag bdun pa 'the seventh day'
glossary.བདེ་བར་གཤེགས་པའི: bde bar gshegs pa'i — of the Sugatas, of those gone to bliss (bde bar 'to bliss' + gshegs pa 'gone' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit sugata): a name of a buddha
glossary.བཞུགས་ཚུལ: bzhugs tshul — manner of sitting (bzhugs, the respectful 'sit' + tshul 'manner')
glossary.བར་དོ: bar do — the between: the interval between two states, above all between death and rebirth (bar 'between' + do 'two')
glossary.བརྒྱན་པ: brgyan pa — adorned, decorated (brgyan, past of rgyan 'to adorn', + -pa)
glossary.བལྟ་སྟངས: blta stangs — manner of looking, gaze (blta, the future stem of lta 'to look', + stangs 'manner'; also written lta stangs)
glossary.བསུ་བ: bsu ba — meeting, welcoming, going out to meet someone (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba); bsu ba la 'ongs 'come to meet'
glossary.བསྐྱལ་དུ: bskyal du — to bring (bskyal, the past and future stem of skyel 'bring', + -du): bskyal du gsol 'I pray that you bring'
glossary.བསྒྲལ: bsgral — to free, freed (bsgral, the past and future stem of sgrol 'free'): bsgral nas 'having freed'
glossary.བསྒྲལ་དུ: bsgral du — to free, to deliver (bsgral, future stem of sgrol 'to free', + -du): bsgral du gsol 'I pray that you free'
glossary.བུ: bu — child, son (bu): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
glossary.བྱ: bya — is to be done; called (bya, future of byed 'do'): zhes bya 'is called' · with 'I' as the doer: 'I shall do' (bya, future of byed), as in ngo shes bya 'I shall recognise'
glossary.བྱ་བ: bya ba — called; what is to be done (bya, future of byed 'do', + ba). zhes bya ba: 'so called'
glossary.བྱེད་ཅིག: byed cig — do (byed, the present stem of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command): with ma, a prohibition, ma byed cig 'do not do!' (the imperative of byed is gyis)
glossary.བྱེད་པར: byed par — doing (byed pa + -r): ma byed par 'without doing'
glossary.བྱོན་པར: byon par — having come, come (byon, the past stem of 'byon, the respectful 'come', + -pa + -r): byon par 'dug gis 'have come, and so'
glossary.བླ་ན་མེད་པ: bla na med pa — unsurpassed, with none above (bla na 'above' + med pa 'without'; Sanskrit anuttara)
glossary.བླ་མའི: bla ma'i — of the lama (bla ma + -'i 'of')
glossary.བླ་མས: bla mas — by the lama (bla ma + -s 'by')
glossary.བླངས: blangs — taken (blangs, the past stem of len 'take'): lus blangs 'taken a body', that is, born
glossary.མ: ma — not (before past and imperative verbs) · in a prohibition also before the present stem: ma byed cig 'do not do!' · mother (ma): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
glossary.མཁའ་འགྲོ་མ: mkha' 'gro ma — sky-goer woman, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go' + -ma, feminine; Sanskrit ḍākinī)
glossary.མཁའ་སྤྱོད: mkha' spyod — Sky-Faring (mkha' 'sky' + spyod 'move about, enjoy'; Sanskrit khecara): the realm of the beings who move in space
glossary.མངལ: mngal — womb (mngal): mngal gyi sgo 'the door of the womb'
glossary.མཆིའོ: mchi'o — I go (mchi, the humble 'go', + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.མཉམ་དུ: mnyam du — together, along with (mnyam 'equal, same' + -du)
glossary.མཉམ་པ་ཉིད: mnyam pa nyid — sameness, equality (mnyam pa 'equal' + nyid '-ness')
glossary.མཐོང་བ: mthong ba — seeing (mthong 'see' + -ba): mthong ba tsam gyis 'by merely seeing'
glossary.མདུན་པ: mdun pa — uncertain; mdun pa 'front' seems to stand for 'dun pa 'aspiration, intent', which the other recension has
glossary.མཚེར་བ: mtsher ba — shimmering (the print's spelling, read as 'tsher ba; mtsher is no known word)
glossary.མཛད་པ: mdzad pa — making, doing (mdzad pa, the respectful 'make')
glossary.མར: mar — down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward' · butter (mar), another word of the same spelling
glossary.མི: mi — not (before present and future verbs) · person, human being (mi): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has known'
glossary.མི་ཡུལ་དུ: mi yul du — in the human world, in the land of humans (mi 'person' + yul 'land' + -du 'in')
glossary.མིའི: mi'i — of humans, of a human (mi 'human' + -'i 'of')
glossary.མུ་ཁྱུད: mu khyud — rim, border, enclosing ring (mu khyud)
glossary.མེ་རེ་རེ: me re re — quivering, flickering shimmer (me re re, a doubled-sound word)
glossary.མེད་པ: med pa — without, not existing (med + pa)
glossary.མེད་པའི: med pa'i — that is without (med pa + -'i 'of')
glossary.མེད་བས: med bas — because there is not (med 'be without' + -bas, the print's b for p of -pas)
glossary.མོས་གུས: mos gus — devotion and respect (mos 'devotion' + gus 'respect')
glossary.མོས་པ: mos pa — devotion, trust, interest (mos pa)
glossary.ཙམ་པ: tsam pa — about the size of, as much as (tsam 'as much as' + -pa)
glossary.ཚེ་འདས: tshe 'das — one whose life has passed, the dead person (tshe 'life' + 'das 'gone beyond')
glossary.ཚོམ་བུས: tshom bus — by clusters (tshom bu 'cluster, bunch' + -s 'by')
glossary.ཞག: zhag — day, a day and night (zhag)
glossary.ཞི་བ: zhi ba — peaceful (zhi ba); the peaceful ones, the peaceful deities, as against khro bo, the wrathful
glossary.ཞིག: zhig — a, some, one (zhig, the form of cig, gcig 'one', after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; shig after s): gzhan zhig 'some other, another'
glossary.ཞིང: zhing — and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm'
glossary.ཞིང་ཁམས་སུ: zhing khams su — in the realm, in the buddha-field (zhing khams 'realm' + -su 'in')
glossary.ཞེ: zhe — so, thus (zhe, the form zhes takes before na after ng, n, m, r, l, ' and a vowel; ce na after g, d, b, she na after s): gang zhe na 'if one asks which', the way a list is opened
glossary.ཞེན་པར: zhen par — clinging (zhen pa 'cling' + -r): ma zhen par 'without clinging'
glossary.ཞེས: zhes — so, thus: closes a quotation or a name (like inverted commas)
glossary.ཞོག་ཅིག: zhog cig — leave it! rest! (zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', + cig, which marks a command)
glossary.འཁོར་བ: 'khor ba — saṃsāra, the round ('khor ba, 'the round of rebirth')
glossary.འཁོར་བའི: 'khor ba'i — of saṃsāra, of the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཁོར་བར: 'khor bar — in saṃsāra, in the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -r 'in')
glossary.འཁྱམས་དུ: 'khyams du — wandering ('khyams 'wander' + -du, written where the rule gives -su after -s): 'khyams du 'ong 'come wandering'
glossary.འཁྱམས་པའི: 'khyams pa'i — of wandering, when one wanders ('khyams 'wander' + -pa'i 'of')
glossary.འཁྲུལ་བའི: 'khrul ba'i — of delusion, deluded ('khrul 'be deluded' + -ba + -'i 'of'): ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'the impure appearances of delusion'
glossary.འགྱུར་བ: 'gyur ba — change, changing ('gyur 'change' + -ba): 'gyur ba med par 'without change'
glossary.འགྱུར་རོ: 'gyur ro — becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
glossary.འགྲོ་བ: 'gro ba — going; a being, a living creature ('gro 'go' + -ba: 'one who goes')
glossary.འཆར་དུ: 'char du — to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'
glossary.འཇིགས་པའི: 'jigs pa'i — of fear, fearful, terrifying ('jigs pa 'fear' + -'i 'of')
glossary.འཐིབ་པའི: 'thib pa'i — of gathering thick, thick ('thib pa 'gather thick', as clouds do, + -'i 'of')
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དུ: 'di skad du — in these words, thus ('di 'this' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')
glossary.འདི་སྐད་དོ: 'di skad do — these words (are said) ('di 'this' + skad 'speech' + the sentence-ending -do)
glossary.འདུག: 'dug — to sit, to stay; in speech 'is, there is', like yod; after a verb also 'seems' ('dug)
glossary.འདྲིས་པའི: 'dris pa'i — of the familiar, one has been familiar with ('dris pa 'be familiar' + -'i 'of'): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has been familiar with'
glossary.འཕྲང: 'phrang — narrow passage, defile, a dangerous place on a road ('phrang)
glossary.འཕྲད་པ: 'phrad pa — meeting ('phrad 'meet' + -pa): ma dang bu 'phrad pa 'mother and child meeting'
glossary.འཕྲོད: 'phrod — to meet, to be received (ngo 'phrod: 'the face is met', to recognise)
glossary.འཕྲོད་པར: 'phrod par — recognition coming, being met ('phrod 'meet' + -pa + -r): ngo sprad kyang mi 'phrod par 'though pointed out, without recognition coming'
glossary.འབྱུང་ངོ: 'byung ngo — occurs, arises ('byung 'occur' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mang du 'byung ngo 'occur in great number'
glossary.འབྲེལ་མར: 'brel mar — joined, connected ('brel 'be connected' + mar, as in gshibs mar 'side by side')
glossary.འཛིགས: 'dzigs — to fear, to be afraid ('dzigs, the print's spelling of 'jigs): 'jigs shing skrag 'terrified and frightened'
glossary.འཛིན: 'dzin — to hold, to grasp ('dzin, the present stem; past bzung)
glossary.འཛིན་པ: 'dzin pa — grasping, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa): the mind taking hold of what it sees · holding with compassion (thugs rjes 'dzin pa)
glossary.འཛིན་པའི: 'dzin pa'i — of holding, that holds ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -'i 'of'): cha 'dzin pa'i 'holding the part (of)'
glossary.འོ་རྒྱལ་ལོ: 'o rgyal lo — how wearisome!, a cry of weariness ('o rgyal, as 'o brgyal 'weary, worn out', + the sentence-ending -lo); the print writes rgyal lo as one syllable
glossary.འོང: 'ong — comes, happens, it may happen that ('ong 'come')
glossary.འོང་བས: 'ong bas — because it comes, since it will come ('ong 'come' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because')
glossary.འོངས་པ: 'ongs pa — come, having come ('ongs, past of 'ong 'come', + -pa)
glossary.འོད་དུ: 'od du — in light, into light ('od 'light' + -du): 'ja' dang 'od du 'in rainbow and light'
glossary.འོད་ཟེར: 'od zer — ray of light, radiance ('od 'light' + zer 'ray')
glossary.འོད་ལམ: 'od lam — light-path, path of light ('od 'light' + lam 'path')
glossary.ཡང: yang — also, even, though (written kyang after g, d, b, s) · again, once more, at the head of a sentence (yang ngo sprad pa ni 'and the pointing out again')
glossary.ཡབ: yab — father (yab, respectful); the male of a buddha and his consort
glossary.ཡབ་ཡུམ: yab yum — father and mother; a buddha and his consort in union (yab 'father' + yum 'mother')
glossary.ཡི་དམ: yi dam — yidam, one's chosen deity (yi dam)
glossary.ཡི་དྭགས: yi dwags — hungry ghost (yi dwags; Sanskrit preta), a being tormented by hunger and thirst
glossary.ཡིད་ཆེས: yid ches — to trust, to believe (yid 'mind' + ches 'believe')
glossary.ཡིན་ནོ: yin no — is, are (yin 'to be' + the sentence-ending -no)
glossary.ཡིན་བས: yin bas — because it is (yin 'is' + -bas, the print's b for p of -pas 'because')
glossary.ཡིས: yis — by (the 'by' ending after a vowel, used in verse; yis)
glossary.ཡུམ: yum — mother; a buddha's female partner, consort (yum)
glossary.ཡུམ་ཆེན: yum chen — great mother (yum 'mother' + chen 'great'): dbyings kyi yum chen 'the great mothers of the expanse', the five consorts
glossary.ཡེ་ནས: ye nas — at all, ever (with a negative: 'not at all') · from the very first, primordially, without a negative: ye nas lhun gyis grub pa 'present of itself from the beginning'
glossary.ཡེ་ཤེས: ye shes — wisdom, primordial knowing (ye 'from the first' + shes 'know'; Sanskrit jñāna)
glossary.ཡེངས་པར: yengs par — distractedly, in distraction (yengs pa 'to be distracted' + -r): ma yengs par 'undistracted'
glossary.རང་ངོ: rang ngo — one's own face, its own nature (rang 'self' + ngo 'face')
glossary.རང་བཞིན: rang bzhin — own nature, intrinsic nature (rang 'self' + bzhin 'manner')
glossary.རང་རང: rang rang — each its own, each one's own (rang 'self', doubled)
glossary.རང་རྩལ: rang rtsal — own energy, natural play (rang 'self' + rtsal 'skill, power'): what awareness shows of itself
glossary.རང་སྣང་དུ: rang snang du — as one's own appearance (rang snang 'self-appearance' + -du 'as')
glossary.རིག་པ: rig pa — knowing, awareness itself, before any thought
glossary.རིག་པའི: rig pa'i — of knowing, of awareness (rig pa 'knowing' + -'i 'of')
glossary.རིག་འཛིན: rig 'dzin — knowledge-holder (rig pa 'knowledge' + 'dzin 'hold'; Sanskrit vidyādhara): a master of tantric knowledge
glossary.རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ: rigs kyi bu — child of the family, child of noble family (rigs 'family' + kyi 'of' + bu 'son, child'; Sanskrit kulaputra)
glossary.རིགས་དྲུག: rigs drug — the six kinds (rigs 'kind' + drug 'six'): the six classes of beings, the realms of rebirth
glossary.རིགས་ལྔ: rigs lnga — the five families (rigs 'family' + lnga 'five'): the five buddhas, each with his consort and the deities of his family
glossary.རིགས་ལྔས: rigs lngas — by the five families (rigs lnga + -s 'by')
glossary.རིན་ཆེན་འབྱུང་ལྡན: rin chen 'byung ldan — Source of Jewels (rin chen 'jewel, precious thing' + 'byung ldan 'having arising'; Sanskrit Ratnasambhava): the buddha of the south and of the third day
glossary.རེ་རེ: re re — each, one by one (re re, doubled): re re la 'to each one'
glossary.རྒྱན: rgyan — ornament, adornment; to adorn (rgyan, the present stem; past brgyan)
glossary.རྒྱབ: rgyab — back, behind (rgyab): rgyab nas 'from behind'
glossary.རྒྱལ་བ: rgyal ba — victor (rgyal ba), a name of a buddha
glossary.རྒྱུན: rgyun — continuity, unbroken flow (rgyun): rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin 'an absorption of continuity'
glossary.རྟོག་བའི: rtog ba'i — of conceiving, of thinking (rtog 'think, build concepts' + -ba, the print's b for p, + -'i 'of'): mi rtog ba'i ngang 'the state of not conceiving'
glossary.རྟོགས: rtogs — to realise (rtogs): rtogs nas 'having realised'
glossary.རྟོགས་པའི: rtogs pa'i — of discerning, of realising (rtogs pa 'realise, discern' + -'i 'of'): so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes 'the discerning wisdom'
glossary.རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ: rdo rje sems dpa' — Vajrasattva, 'Vajra Being' (rdo rje 'vajra' + sems dpa' 'hero of mind'; Sanskrit vajrasattva): the buddha of the second day, here the same figure as Akṣobhya
glossary.རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའི: rdo rje sems dpa'i — of Vajrasattva (rdo rje sems dpa' + -'i 'of'): the buddha of the second day
glossary.རྣམ་པར: rnam par — completely, in every way (rnam par): rnam par dag pa 'completely pure'
glossary.རྣམ་པར་སྣང་མཛད: rnam par snang mdzad — Vairocana, 'He Who Makes Appear in Every Way' (rnam par 'in every way' + snang 'appear' + mdzad, respectful 'do, make'); the buddha of the centre
glossary.རྣམས: rnams — plural marker, set after the noun and its adjectives
glossary.རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: rtse gcig tu — one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
glossary.རྫོགས་པར: rdzogs par — completely, in full (rdzogs pa 'complete' + -r): gcig la rdzogs par 'complete in one'; the reading rdzogs is not sure on the image
glossary.རྫོགས་པས: rdzogs pas — because it is complete (rdzogs 'be complete' + -pa + -s 'because'): ma rdzogs pas 'because it is not complete'
glossary.ལ: la — to, at, in, for; after a verb or adjective: 'and' · among (… kyi rigs la 'among those of the … kind') · on (… la bzhugs 'seated on …')
glossary.ལ་སོགས་པ: la sogs pa — and the like, and so on (la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera' + -pa)
glossary.ལམ་སྣ: lam sna — head of the road, the way ahead (lam 'path' + sna 'front, head'): lam sna drongs 'lead the way'
glossary.ལས: las — from, out of · karma, action (las): las kyi 'of karma'; after a verb or noun, 'other than, of, from among'
glossary.ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur — as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku + -r 'as')
glossary.ལྔ་ཚན: lnga tshan — a set of five (lnga 'five' + tshan 'group')
glossary.ལྔ་རུ: lnga ru — to five (lnga + -ru 'to'): zhing mchog lnga ru 'to the five supreme realms'
glossary.ལྔ་ལྔའི: lnga lnga'i — of five and five, of the fives (lnga lnga + -'i 'of'): perhaps the five buddhas, each with his consort; the sense is not sure
glossary.ལྔ་ལྔས: lnga lngas — by fives, five by five (lnga lnga + -s 'by')
glossary.ལྟ་བུ: lta bu — like, of the kind of (lta bu)
glossary.ལྟ་བུའམ: lta bu'am — like, or (lta bu 'like' + -'am 'or'): the first of two likenesses
glossary.ལྟ་བུའི: lta bu'i — like, of the kind of (lta bu 'like' + -'i): me long lta bu'i 'like a mirror'
glossary.ལྡན་པ: ldan pa — having, endowed with (ldan 'have, possess' + -pa)
glossary.ལྡོག་གོ: ldog go — turns (ldog 'turn' + the sentence-ending -go): phyir mi ldog go 'does not turn back'
glossary.ལྷ་མ་ཡིན: lha ma yin — demigod, asura (lha ma yin 'not-god'): a being who wars with the gods out of envy
glossary.ལྷ་ཚོགས: lha tshogs — host of deities (lha 'god' + tshogs 'host, gathering')
glossary.ལྷུན་གྲུབ: lhun grub — spontaneous presence (lhun grub, short for lhun gyis grub pa 'accomplished of itself'): lhun grub chen po'i sku 'the body of great spontaneous presence'
glossary.ཤར་བའི: shar ba'i — of what dawned, that dawned (shar, the past stem of 'char 'dawn', + -ba + -'i 'of')
glossary.ཤས་ཆེ་བ: shas che ba — the greater part, the majority (shas 'part, share' + che ba 'great')
glossary.ཤིང: shing — and, while (links two verbs; also cing, zhing)
glossary.ཤེས: shes — to know, to recognise (shes); ngo shes 'recognise, know the face'
glossary.ཤེས་པས: shes pas — because of knowing (shes pa 'knowing' + -s 'because'): ma shes pas 'because you did not know'
glossary.སངས་རྒྱའོ: sangs rgya'o — becomes a buddha (sangs rgya, the present stem, + the sentence-ending -'o)
glossary.སངས་རྒྱས་པར: sangs rgyas par — to being a buddha, as a buddha (sangs rgyas 'buddha' + -pa + -r 'to'): sangs rgyas par 'gyur 'become a buddha'
glossary.སེམས་དཔའ: sems dpa' — hero, bodhisattva (sems 'mind' + dpa' 'hero'; short for byang chub sems dpa', 'hero of awakening')
glossary.སེམས་མ: sems ma — female bodhisattva (sems ma, short for sems dpa' ma)
glossary.སོ་སོར: so sor — one by one, each by itself (so so 'each' + -r): so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself'
glossary.སྐུ་མདོག: sku mdog — body colour, colour of a buddha or deity (sku 'body' + mdog 'colour'), the respectful word
glossary.སྐྱབས་སུ: skyabs su — for refuge, as refuge (skyabs 'refuge' + -su 'to'): skyabs su mchi'o 'I go for refuge'
glossary.སྐྱེས: skyes — arisen, born (skyes, past of skye 'be born, arise')
glossary.སྐྱོར: skyor — to hold up, to support (skyor, the present stem, which also serves as the imperative 'hold up!'; past and future bskyor)
glossary.སྐྲག: skrag — to be frightened, to be terrified (skrag); fright
glossary.སྐྲག་པར: skrag par — being frightened, to be frightened (skrag pa 'fright' + -r); ma skrag par 'without fear'
glossary.སྒྲོ་འདོགས: sgro 'dogs — superimposition, doubt (sgro 'feather' + 'dogs 'tie'): what the mind adds to what is there
glossary.སྙིང་ཁར: snying khar — at the heart, into the heart (snying kha 'heart' + -r 'at, into')
glossary.སྟེ: ste — and, namely: a linking word after a verb or a statement, leading on to what follows (also te, de)
glossary.སྟེང་དུ: steng du — on top of, on (steng 'top' + -du 'at')
glossary.སྣང་ངོ: snang ngo — appears (snang 'appear' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mi snang ngo 'does not appear'
glossary.སྣང་བ: snang ba — appearance, what appears to the senses or the mind; light
glossary.སྣང་བ་མཐའ་ཡས: snang ba mtha' yas — Boundless Appearance, Boundless Light: the buddha Amitābha (snang ba 'appearance, light' + mtha' yas 'without limit')
glossary.སྣམ་བུ: snam bu — strip of woollen cloth (snam bu); a band, as of light
glossary.སྣམ་བུའི: snam bu'i — of the strip (snam bu + -'i 'of')
glossary.སྦ་ཐག: sba thag — cord of cane (sba 'cane' + thag 'rope, cord'); the likeness is not sure
glossary.སྦྱོར: sbyor — to join, to unite (sbyor, the present stem; past and future sbyar): ye shes bzhi sbyor 'the four wisdoms joined'
glossary.སྨིན་པའི: smin pa'i — of ripening, of the ripened (smin pa 'ripen' + -'i 'of'): rnam par smin pa'i 'of full ripening'
glossary.སྨོན་ལམ: smon lam — prayer of aspiration (smon 'to wish' + lam 'path')

about: This part ends the sixth day and begins the seventh. The forty-two deities who dawned at the end of the last part are described: neither large nor small, with their thrones and gestures, the five buddhas and their consorts in pairs, the bodhisattvas around them, the whole maṇḍala complete at once. Then from the hearts of the five families come the light-rays of the four wisdoms joined: on a strip of white light a white drop like a mirror turned face down, then a blue drop like a turquoise bowl, a yellow one like a golden bowl, and a red one like a bowl of coral. The green light of the fifth wisdom does not appear, because the energy of the dead man's awareness is not yet complete; the four together are called the path of the inner hollow of Vajrasattva. He is to remember his lama's instruction and know them again, as a child and its mother know each other when they meet. Beside them dawn the six dull lights of the six kinds of beings, which lead to rebirth, and he is to turn from them and say a prayer to the five families. Those who make it are freed, the middling by fierce devotion, and all through its power; most recognise the peaceful deities. But for the lowest, who had no tendency toward the teaching, the seventh day comes: the knowledge-holders come to meet them from the Sky-Faring realm, with the dull light of the animals, and the first of them dawns in a mass of rainbow light, the Lord of the Lotus Dance with his consort.
